name: mcp-stock-analyst
title: MCP Stock Analyst
description: Remote MCP server for stock data: real-time quotes, fuzzy search (Chinese / pinyin / code / English ticker) and historical K-lines across 13 markets — China A-shares, Hong Kong, US, Taiwan, Japan, India, Canada, South Korea, UK, France, Singapore, Germany, Malaysia. Free upstream data sources (Tencent + Yahoo Finance), no API key required. Tools: get_quote, search_stock, get_kline.

inputSchema.title: MCP Stock Analyst
inputSchema.description: This Actor is a remote MCP server and does not take a manual input. Connect your MCP client to the Actor's standby endpoint (see README) and call the tools from there.
